recommended_actions: Immediately isolate WS-FIN-07 and SRV-FILES-01 from the network using EDR to prevent further compromise.
Disable the svc_backup account and force a password reset for all associated services and applications.
Kill the process and remove the persistence mechanism related to OneDriveSyncHelper (%APPDATA%\sync.exe) on WS-FIN-07.
